say:1:1130322001:1.text: Soren hails from the Grimmaw Clan but doesn't represent them when it matters most.
say:1:1130322001:1.source_cn: 索恩出身黑嚎氏族，却在关键的时候不代表黑嚎氏族出场。

say:1:1130322001:1.female: Soren hails from the Grimmaw Clan but doesn't represent them when it matters most.

say:2:1130322002:1.text: As he got stronger he could have returned any time!
say:2:1130322002:1.source_cn: 明明只要他变强，我们随时都欢迎他回来！
